text: Hello drawfriends! I'd like to request my lovely husbando Orihara Izaya playing ice hockey. If you don't like that, here's some more ideas if you want: -On one of the album covers in this collection: https://imgur.com/a/wLonMwK . There's no order to the albums or any preference, so just choose one that you like! And don't worry about replicating it perfectly, text is optional. -Reaction images. Feel free to pick one you like and put him in. -SI: https://imgur.com/a/iqbTwAy Please let me know if the links don't work. Of course, if you would like to do something else that would also be great. Thank you and have a great day!
